result.summary: In 2018 Suleyman, then at DeepMind, wrote and spoke mostly about AI ethics, governance and AI for the Sustainable Development Goals. He made no dated forecasts about AI capabilities and said nothing about AGI timelines in what I read. His dated forward-looking lines are about AI ethics and governance (a January Wired essay and a December Wired essay) and a conditional claim in a UN speech that the goals would be far exceeded by 2030; all three are borderline under the rules.

reply_text:
I found no 2018 statement in which Suleyman gave a date for something AI itself would do or achieve. He also said nothing in 2018 about when AGI might arrive, at least in what I read. I did find three dated forward-looking lines from his own 2018 writing and speeches, and all three are borderline. Two predict that work on AI ethics and governance will grow, not what AI will do. The third is conditional ("if we can create the right structures..."). I've listed them so you can decide; you may reasonably exclude them.

**Checks on dates and sources:**
- **The January 2018 Wired piece.** I read it on Suleyman's personal site, which dates it 5 January 2018 and links to the Wired original. I didn't open the Wired page itself. Wired's "World in 2018" pieces often appear in print in December of the year before, so check the date there.
- **The UN speech.** I read it as a PDF on the UN General Assembly President's site. It isn't dated. The file is stored in a 2018/01 folder and cites a January 2018 article. A UN agenda lists Suleyman meeting the Assembly President at 11:00 on 11 June 2018, but nothing on that agenda shows this was when he gave the speech. So I've given only "2018" as the date.
- **The Economist essay (20 September 2018).** It seems to reuse wording from the UN speech, but only its first few paragraphs loaded, with no forecasts in them. I haven't quoted it.
- **Searches.** All three fixed searches ran. Their results were almost entirely about 2023–2026 claims, such as the "12–18 months" automation forecast and "by 2029". I used 10 of the 12 searches and all 6 page openings.
